title: Stokes' formula for an oriented plane and its coordinate half-planes
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, n := d+1, v = (v_0, …, v_d) an orthonormal family in ℝ^P, V₀ := span(v_0, …, v_d), and φ a test d-form on ℝ^P (φ ∈ TestFormOn univ d: smooth with compact support). Write dφ = exteriorDerivative φ, Hᵐ = μHE[m], (v_1, …, v_d) = Fin.tail v, and for t ∈ ℝ let L_t := {y ∈ ℝ^P : y − t v_0 ∈ span(v_1, …, v_d)}. Then (a) ∫_{V₀} dφ(y)(v_0, …, v_d) dHⁿ(y) = 0, and (b) for every t ∈ ℝ, ∫_{V₀ ∩ {y : ⟨y, v_0⟩ < t}} dφ(y)(v_0, …, v_d) dHⁿ(y) = ∫_{L_t} φ(y)(v_1, …, v_d) dH^d(y).
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (v : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ v → ∀ φ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, (∫ y in (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) : Set (Euclid P)), exteriorDerivative (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) y v ∂μHE[(d + 1)] = 0) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, ∫ y in (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ {y : Euclid P | inner ℝ y (v 0) < t}, exteriorDerivative (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) y v ∂μHE[(d + 1)] = ∫ y in {y : Euclid P | y - t • v 0 ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (Fin.tail v))}, (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) y (Fin.tail v) ∂μHE[d]
